candidates.name: Rahul Narwekar
candidates.manifesto: Accelerated urban infrastructure renewal, coastal road South Mumbai connectivity, redevelopment of transit and cessed buildings, free healthcare diagnostics in municipal wards, and youth entrepreneurship incubation.
candidates.biography: Advocate & Speaker of Maharashtra Legislative Assembly. Educational Qualification: LL.M, Government Law College Mumbai. Age: 47. Declared Assets (Form 26): ₹38.2 Crores. Criminal Cases: Nil. Permanent Resident of Colaba, Mumbai.

candidates.name: Arvind Sawant
candidates.manifesto: Protection of Mumbai Port Trust (MbPT) lands for public housing and open spaces, job reservations for local youth, strengthening public healthcare institutions, and protection of traditional fishing communities.
candidates.biography: Senior Parliamentarian & Former Union Cabinet Minister. Educational Qualification: B.Sc., Bhavan's College Mumbai. Age: 72. Declared Assets (Form 26): ₹4.8 Crores. Criminal Cases: Nil. Resident of Sewri, Mumbai.

candidates.name: Milind Deora
candidates.manifesto: Transformation of South Mumbai into India's premier FinTech and AI cluster, single-window clearance for MSMEs, pedestrian-first urban corridors, and heritage precinct restoration.
candidates.biography: Former Union Minister of State for Communications and IT. Educational Qualification: B.B.A, Boston University. Age: 47. Declared Assets (Form 26): ₹52.4 Crores. Criminal Cases: Nil. Resident of Pedder Road, Mumbai.

candidates.name: Anand Swarup Joshi
candidates.manifesto: 100% transparent audit of municipal ward funds, citizen-driven participatory budgeting, rooftop rainwater harvesting subsidies, and barrier-free pedestrian accessibility.
candidates.biography: Civic Activist & Environmental Engineer. Educational Qualification: M.Tech (IIT Bombay). Age: 39. Declared Assets (Form 26): ₹65 Lakhs. Criminal Cases: Nil. Resident of Girgaon, Mumbai.

candidates.name: Arvind Kejriwal
candidates.manifesto: Continuation of 200 units free lifeline electricity, 20,000 liters free clean drinking water, world-class Delhi government schools, free bus travel for women, and expansion of 500 Mohalla Clinics across all wards.
candidates.biography: Former Chief Minister of Delhi & National Convener AAP. Educational Qualification: B.Tech (IIT Kharagpur). Age: 56. Declared Assets (Form 26): ₹3.44 Crores. Criminal Cases: Disclosed in Form 26 under trial. Resident of Civil Lines, Delhi.

candidates.name: Sunil Yadav
candidates.manifesto: Mission Clean Yamuna within 3 years, complete regularization of unauthorized colonies with registered registry papers, PM Awas Yojana housing for slum dwellers, and AI-enabled traffic control systems.
candidates.biography: President Delhi Bharatiya Janata Yuva Morcha. Educational Qualification: M.A., LL.B. Age: 46. Declared Assets (Form 26): ₹6.12 Crores. Criminal Cases: Nil. Resident of Sarojini Nagar, New Delhi.

candidates.name: Virender Singh Rathore
candidates.manifesto: Re-establishment of the Sheila Dikshit infrastructure development model, pollution emergency mitigation grid, subsidized LPG cylinders at ₹500, and modern multimodal bus rapid transit integration.
candidates.biography: AICC Secretary & Advocate Supreme Court of India. Educational Qualification: LL.M, Delhi University. Age: 51. Declared Assets (Form 26): ₹8.90 Crores. Criminal Cases: Nil. Resident of Greater Kailash, New Delhi.

candidates.name: Narendra Modi
candidates.manifesto: Viksit Bharat 2047 roadmap, expansion of PM Kisan Samman Nidhi, creation of 3 crore Lakhpati Didis, universal Ayushman Bharat health insurance for citizens aged 70+, and world-class high-speed rail corridors.
candidates.biography: Prime Minister of India. Member of Parliament from Varanasi Parliamentary Constituency. Educational Qualification: M.A. (Gujarat University). Age: 74. Declared Assets (Form 26): ₹3.02 Crores. Criminal Cases: Nil.

candidates.name: Mallikarjun Kharge
candidates.manifesto: Nyay Patra 2024: Mahalakshmi guarantee of ₹1 Lakh per year to poorest families, 30 Lakh central government job vacancies filled, statutory legal MSP guarantee for farmers, and national caste census.
candidates.biography: Leader of Opposition in Rajya Sabha & President Indian National Congress. Educational Qualification: B.A., LL.B. Age: 82. Declared Assets (Form 26): ₹21.5 Crores. Criminal Cases: Nil. Resident of Bengaluru / Kalaburagi.

candidates.name: Akhilesh Yadav
candidates.manifesto: PDA (Pichhde, Dalit, Alpasankhyak) social justice charter, restoration of the Old Pension Scheme (OPS), laptop distribution for higher education students, and agricultural loan waivers.
candidates.biography: Former Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh & Member of Parliament from Kannauj. Educational Qualification: B.E., M.Tech (Univ of Sydney). Age: 51. Declared Assets (Form 26): ₹26.3 Crores. Criminal Cases: Nil.

Loudspeaker and sound amplification system operated at 82 dB beyond 10:00 PM in residential area (Violation of Rule 5 of Noise Pollution Rules 2000 and ECI Instruction No. 464/INST/2014-EPS).
compliance_violations.investigation_notes: Flying Squad Team (FST-3) dispatched to the spot. Sound equipment impounded under Panchnama. Show cause notice issued to the campaign manager returnable in 24 hours.

compliance_violations.description: Affixing election posters and banners on metro rail viaduct pillars and government hospital perimeter wall without written NOC (Violation of Defacement of Public Property Act / ECI circular No. 437/6/INST/2015-CCS).
compliance_violations.investigation_notes: District Nodal Officer (MCC) directed municipal sanitation staff to remove all 48 unauthorized hoardings. Costs assessed at ₹18,400 debited to candidate election expenditure account.

compliance_violations.description: Static Surveillance Team (SST) intercepted transport vehicle carrying un-invoiced domestic cookware and gift packets near polling station periphery (IPC Section 171B / Bribery in Elections).
compliance_violations.investigation_notes: Items seized in presence of Executive Magistrate. Joint inventory prepared. Formal FIR No. 214/2026 registered at local police station under Section 171B and Section 123 of RP Act 1951.

compliance_violations.description: Verbal appeal made invoking caste and religious sentiments to solicit votes during a public meeting at Shivaji Maidan (Violation of MCC Clause I.3 and Section 123(3) of Representation of the People Act, 1951).
compliance_violations.investigation_notes: Video Surveillance Team (VST) CD submitted to Returning Officer. Transcript examined by District Legal Cell. Report forwarded to State Chief Electoral Officer for further ECI referral.

compliance_violations.description: Sponsored political promotional advertisements circulated on digital messaging channels during the 48-hour silence period preceding polling end (Violation of Section 126 of Representation of the People Act, 1951).
compliance_violations.investigation_notes: Media Certification and Monitoring Committee (MCMC) issued immediate notice to intermediary platform. Ad campaign geoblocked with immediate effect within the constituency boundaries.
